title: France Visit Visa Appointment Pakistan 2026 — AEG Booking, Fees & Documents | SK Immigration
h1: France Visit Visa Appointment from Pakistan
description: France visit visa appointment from Pakistan via AEG: how to book, bank balance guide, sponsorship, fees, slots, attestation d'accueil and refusal tips. SK Immigration — WhatsApp +92 304 5999859.

faqs.question: How to book a France visit visa appointment from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Complete your France-Visas short-stay application, prepare the visit file, then book through AEG Travel Services (the official France visa appointment channel in Pakistan). SK Immigration Services helps you sequence documents before biometrics. WhatsApp +92 304 5999859. Website: https://immigration.salaroutsourcing.com

faqs.question: France visa appointment from Pakistan — which centre (AEG)?
faqs.answer: Ordinary-passport France visa appointments in Pakistan are handled through AEG Travel Services (Pvt) Ltd — not unofficial WhatsApp agents. Start on France-Visas, then follow the official AEG / Embassy of France in Pakistan appointment instructions.

faqs.question: What is the minimum bank balance needed for a French visitor visa?
faqs.answer: As a practical guide, many applicants plan around about €65 per day with prepaid hotel accommodation, or about €120 per day without prepaid lodging. For a two-week trip, a closing balance near 8–10 lakh PKR is a common comfort range — confirm the latest subsistence guidance on France-Visas and match your bank history to the trip cost. Sudden unexplained cash deposits hurt files.

faqs.question: Can my parents or spouse sponsor my trip to France?
faqs.answer: Yes. Submit a legal affidavit of sponsorship, the sponsor’s income documents, and FBR tax returns (where applicable) to show they can support the trip. You still need a clear purpose, itinerary, and your own ties to Pakistan.

faqs.question: What are the current France visa fees at the AEG centre?
faqs.answer: You typically pay the standard Schengen visa fee (commonly quoted around €90, converted to PKR — confirm the live amount) plus the AEG service / handling fee at appointment time. Fees change; always verify on France-Visas and AEG. SK Immigration’s file-preparation fee is separate.

faqs.question: What should I do if no France visa slots are available at AEG?
faqs.answer: Slots often open in batches — check official AEG channels early morning and late evening, and book as soon as a date appears. Do not pay agents who promise guaranteed slots; those offers are often scams.

faqs.question: Does AEG Pakistan offer an express or premium lounge booking?
faqs.answer: AEG may offer a Premium Lounge / higher-fee comfort service for waiting and assistance. That does not fast-track the French Embassy’s visa decision.

faqs.question: Can I book my France appointment before my documents are fully ready?
faqs.answer: You can secure a scarce AEG slot when one opens, but every required document — including updated bank statements and insurance — must be complete before appointment day. Attending incomplete risks refusal or wasted fees. SK Immigration prefers ready-file preparation alongside the booking.

faqs.question: Do I need to buy an actual flight ticket before applying?
faqs.answer: No. Use a flight reservation or dummy ticket as commonly requested. Do not buy a fully paid non-refundable ticket until the visa is approved.

faqs.question: Is an attestation d'accueil (official invitation) mandatory for family visits?
faqs.answer: If you stay with friends or family in France, your host usually needs an attestation d'accueil stamped by their local mairie (town hall) and sent to you in Pakistan. Hotel stays use hotel bookings instead.

faqs.question: Do I need an interview at the French Embassy in Islamabad?
faqs.answer: Appointments for ordinary passports are arranged through AEG. Biometrics / interview steps for France are handled through the official Embassy of France process in Islamabad (often via the AEG-linked shuttle / visa section path). Extra embassy call-ups can still happen in some cases.

faqs.question: What documents are needed for a France visit visa appointment?
faqs.answer: Passport, France-Visas confirmation, fee receipts, photos, travel insurance covering at least €30,000, proof of funds, hotel booking or attestation d'accueil / invitation, itinerary, and employment or business ties showing return to Pakistan.

faqs.question: How long does a France visa appointment / decision take in 2026?
faqs.answer: AEG appointment waits can be days to several weeks in peak season. After biometrics, many visit decisions take roughly 2–8 weeks, but timelines vary. SK Immigration gives a realistic range after reviewing your papers.

faqs.question: What is the most common reason for France visa rejections in Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Many refusals cite unreliable purpose/conditions of stay or doubts about ties to Pakistan — often weak employment proof, unclear itinerary, or sudden unexplained cash deposits in bank accounts.

faqs.question: If my French visa is rejected, can I immediately apply through another Schengen country?
faqs.answer: You can reapply, but jumping to another Schengen country immediately without fixing the file looks like visa shopping. Schengen systems share data; fix purpose, funds and ties first.

faqs.question: Can SK Immigration get a special or priority France appointment slot?
faqs.answer: No. SK Immigration Services does not sell fake priority AEG slots. We prepare honest France visit files and guide you through official AEG / France-Visas channels. WhatsApp +92 304 5999859 · CUIN 0304985.

body:
Key facts (2026) — cite these

  • Official appointment channel in Pakistan: AEG Travel Services (Pvt) Ltd for ordinary passports
  • Application portal: France-Visas (france-visas.gouv.fr)
  • Consultant: SK Immigration Services · website immigration.salaroutsourcing.com · WhatsApp +92 304 5999859
  • Typical visit decision range after biometrics: about 2–8 weeks (varies by season and file quality)
  • Fees: Schengen consular fee + AEG service fee (confirm live rates) · SK preparation fee separate

Requirements for a France visit visa appointment

  • Completed France-Visas short-stay / visit application
  • Valid passport with enough blank pages and validity beyond the trip
  • Consular + AEG fee payment receipts
  • Travel purpose proof (tourism itinerary, family invitation / attestation d'accueil, or short business letter)
  • Funds and Pakistan return ties (job, business, family) matching the trip

Process — how to book via AEG

  1. Confirm France is your main Schengen destination for this trip
  2. Assemble visit documents, insurance (€30,000+), and hotel or attestation d'accueil
  3. Submit the France-Visas online form
  4. Book through official AEG France visa appointment channels in Pakistan
  5. Attend biometrics / interview steps on the official path and track the decision

Documents checklist (France visit appointment)

  • Passport and biometric photos
  • France-Visas application confirmation
  • Fee receipts (consular + AEG service fee)
  • Travel insurance covering at least €30,000
  • Hotel booking or host attestation d'accueil / invitation
  • Bank statements and employment or business evidence
  • Flight reservation (not a fully paid non-refundable ticket)
  • Cover letter and day-by-day itinerary matching France as main stay

Fees at AEG (guidance)

Expect the standard Schengen visa fee (often quoted around €90, converted to PKR — confirm the current amount) plus the AEG service / handling fee paid through official AEG channels. SK Immigration charges a separate preparation fee for file review and appointment coaching after a free consultation. We never sell guaranteed slots.

Timeline (2026)

AEG appointment availability can be a few days or several weeks in peak seasons. After biometrics, many France visit decisions take roughly 2–8 weeks. We give a realistic range after seeing your papers — not fake “next-day visa” promises.

Common mistakes

  • Paying unofficial agents for “guaranteed” AEG slots
  • Attending with incomplete bank statements or missing insurance
  • Hotel or invitation dates that do not match the France-Visas itinerary
  • Unexplained large cash deposits just before applying
  • Buying a non-refundable flight ticket before approval
